singleSourced.value: Oooh, look how they changed that bit!
singleSourced.context: Knowing the original game like the back of my hand, I'm yet to walk into a room without going, "Oooh, look how they changed that bit!" But the one that has stood out to me the most so far is being able to ride Epona right up to the entrance to Kakariko Village without getting chucked off at the bottom of the stairs.
